description: A company's most recent SEC filings, optionally filtered by form type (e.g. 10-K,8-K) and date, with filing/report dates, 8-K item numbers and direct links to the document and filing index. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.002 USDC on Base)

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (alternative to ticker).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. Provide ticker or cik.
